text:
Philadelphia yɛ William Penn na ɔde too hɔ wɔ 1682 mu na ɛkɔɔ so yɛɛ kurow a ɛso paa wɔ American colonies mu, na ɛyɛ United States capital wɔ Revolutionary era no mu. Ɛyɛ American independence awoɔbea: Declaration of Independence wɔ 1776 ne U.S. Constitution wɔ 1787 no sign wɔ Independence Hall. N’adwene a ɛwɔ hɔ no ma kurow no wɔ 2026 World Cup map no so yɛ anisoɔden, ɛfiri sɛ Philadelphia de Round of 16 match bɛto July 4 — Independence Day — wɔ United States 250th-anniversary year no mu.

America kurow biara nni hɔ a wɔde wɔn agoru ho anigyeɛ kyerɛ openly sɛ Philadelphia. Metro no kura fan base a ɛyɛ den paa a ɛfa Eagles wɔ NFL, Phillies wɔ MLB, 76ers wɔ NBA ne Flyers wɔ NHL, na anigyeɛ yi trɛ region no nyinaa mu, ɛnyɛ team baako pɛ. Soccer fam no, metro no kura MLS side Philadelphia Union, a wɔagoru wɔ Subaru Park wɔ Chester fi 2010, na ɛde top-flight professional presence a ɛwɔ hɔ ma agoru no wɔ mpɛn no mu.

Kurow no international football pedigree yɛ nokware na wɔde nyaa wɔ venue no ara mu. Lincoln Financial Field agye Copa America Centenario fixtures, 2015 CONCACAF Gold Cup final, ne matches a USMNT de baeɛ, na ɛde genuine top-flight football history a ɛwɔ hɔ no kaa metro a ɛwɔ big-event sport mu. Sɛ yɛka bomu — founding story, constitutional milestones, ne sporting culture a ɛyɛ den sɛnea ɛte wɔ ɔman no mu biara — Philadelphia bɛkɔ 2026 World Cup sɛ host city a civic identity ne football fervour hyia wɔ asase koro so.
